description: This file implements the SiloMetadataCache class, which manages caching and updating of silo metadata in an Orleans cluster. It handles membership updates, cache invalidation, and lifecycle participation.

classes.name: SiloMetadataCache
classes.description: A cache managing silo metadata, handling membership updates, cache invalidation, and lifecycle participation within an Orleans cluster.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Registers lifecycle event handlers for starting and stopping the cache processing.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Asynchronously processes membership table updates, updating the cache accordingly.

methods.name: GetSiloMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves cached metadata for a specified silo address.

methods.name: SetMetadata
methods.description: Adds or updates metadata for a specified silo address.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cancels ongoing processing and disposes of resources.
